config_a.name: cardiac_quadratic_reference_halfstep_robust_coarse_v1
config_a.scope: Prospective0.625ms P2/Q6 reference with GMRES/GAMG primary and direct MUMPS fallback on nonconvergence, nonfinite force or force acceptance failure. Both use strict1e-8N absolute/zero-relative stopping and at most100 Newton iterations; same equations/history/predictors/physical acceptance. Coarse runs from rest; refined continues explicitly inherited accepted original450-state prefix plus two independently audited direct states through0.2825s. Preserve original rejected attempts; copied accepted prefixes are provenance-recorded, not re-executed. Full-cycle positivity/norm audits and matched mesh comparison required. Q6 integration uncertainty remains unresolved; no neural retraining or continuum claim.
